plugins.name: blueprint
plugins.description: Intent producer + invariant referee. Produces design docs (motivation, approach, alternatives) and agent-executable specs (interface contract, acceptance scenarios, Definition of Done), hands implementation to any coding agent, then referees the result against the spec — scenario coverage, anti-vacuity check, and Test Desiderata scoring. Tests remain the durable contract.

plugins.name: thinking-craft
plugins.description: Personal thinking tools that coach — not automate — the craft of structured thought. Includes guided note-making, Zettelkasten workflows, and reflective writing practices.
